$comment: The platforms this repository generates agent adapters for, and what each
one can actually enforce. Read by tools/agents/generate_adapters.py and
The roster is not listed here: it is whatever exists under .agents/agents/,
so adding an agent is adding one file. A manifest that also lists the
agents is a second place to forget.

how: The `tools:` frontmatter key is the mechanism. An agent listed without
Write, Edit or NotebookEdit cannot call them -- the restriction is
applied by the harness, not requested of the model.
The agent file carries only name, description and
developer_instructions. There is no tools or permissions key, so a
`writes: none` agent is restricted by instruction alone.
This is a real limitation and is why the generator writes an explicit
paragraph into the Codex body rather than relying on the canonical
prose: on this platform the sentence *is* the whole enforcement.
If Codex gains a tool-restriction key, set enforces_write_denial true
